abstract: Makes an ASOME product or case-study Instagram reel (9:16, ~50 s, Remotion) presenting software ASOME built for a client: it explains the process and ETA in Spanish, asks the product, repo path, user sides, naming permission and format in one message, writes and iterates a five-line script (hook, reveal, business side, emotional side, ASOME close), and generates an ElevenLabs voiceover with word timings and SRT from a key the user loads in their own environment. The reel is a folder of the private asomelab/videos repo (one Remotion project with the shared brand system, created through asome-video's new-reel.sh). It rebuilds the product's screens from the client's code with invented data inside neutral device mockups (never logging into client environments), builds the scenes with parallel agents and one adversarial review each, generates the copy (three angles and an editor), cover and a scene-synced beat in parallel, runs contact-sheet QA on the rendered MP4, and delivers MP4, cover, a publish-ready Instagram package (caption, hashtags, first comment, alt text, cover check, posting time, step-by-step Instagram settings and checklist), SRT, script and voice, optionally copied to the ASOME Drive. The source is committed and pushed at the approved script, the first full build and the final version, with a README section on how to rebuild and vary it. It depends on asome-video and targets under two hours end to end.
